lines: Initiation of living absent also to be performed, seedless but it: in it, in fashioning form resembling darbha, from net-yoga.
l4.sanskrit_cite: jīvatparokṣadīkṣāpi kāryā nirbījikā tu sā tasyāṃ darbhākṛtiprāyakalpane jālayogataḥ
